resumen: With the torso hinged, the arms open out to the back. It is the direct exercise for the back of the shoulder.
ejecucion: Hinge your torso forward with a flat back and let the dumbbells hang.
Open your arms out to the sides with the elbow slightly bent and fixed.
Raise until your hands are level with your shoulders, no higher.
Lower slowly rather than dropping the weight.
If the elbows bend during the rep it turns into a row.
matices: The cited review places this among the exercises that most activate the posterior deltoid, the portion that almost never gets direct load: presses work the front and pulls spread it around. Very little weight moves, and overloading it is the common mistake.
